doc.head: LIBRARY PRINTER
paras: Out of order today. Please use the printer on the second floor. Printing is free until Friday.

qs.stem: Where can students print today?
qs.ex: «Please use the printer on the second floor» — этот принтер не работает, печатать нужно на втором этаже.

qs.stem: What is true about printing this week?
opts: It is not possible until Friday.
qs.ex: «Printing is free until Friday». Печатать можно, просто на другом этаже.

msgs.text: Bus is late again. Can you save me a seat in class?
Sure! Back row, near the window.

qs.stem: Why does Sam write to Lucy?
opts: He wants to sit with her on the bus.
qs.ex: «Bus is late again. Can you save me a seat» — автобус опаздывает, и Сэм просит занять ему место.

qs.stem: Where will Sam sit?
opts: In the back row near the window
qs.ex: «Back row, near the window».

doc.head: POOL CLOSED
paras: The swimming pool is closed on Monday for cleaning. It opens again on Tuesday at 7 a.m. The gym stays open.

qs.stem: Why is the pool closed on Monday?
qs.ex: «…closed on Monday for cleaning».

qs.stem: What can a visitor most likely do on Monday?
qs.ex: «The gym stays open» — в понедельник можно позаниматься в спортзале, а бассейн закрыт весь день.

paras: Found: a black umbrella in the laundry room this morning. It's at my door, room 214. Message me if it's yours!

qs.stem: What is the post mainly about?
qs.ex: «Found: a black umbrella» — Джона нашёл зонт и ищет владельца.

qs.stem: What should the owner do?
qs.ex: «Message me if it's yours!»

doc.head: CAMPUS CAFÉ · TODAY
doc.foot: Students get 10% off with a student card.

qs.stem: How much is soup with bread?
qs.ex: В меню: «Soup + bread — $5». $4 — суп без хлеба.

qs.stem: How can students pay less?
qs.ex: «Students get 10% off with a student card».

doc.head: BIKE RACK NOTICE
paras: Bikes left at the east rack after May 30 will be removed so the area can be repaired. Use the west rack meanwhile. Removed bikes can be collected from Security.

qs.stem: Why will bikes be removed from the east rack?
qs.ex: «…will be removed so the area can be repaired».

qs.stem: What will most likely happen to a bike left at the east rack on June 2?
opts: It will be repaired for free.
It will be moved to the west rack.
It will be taken to Security.
qs.ex: После 30 мая велосипеды уберут, а «Removed bikes can be collected from Security» — значит, велосипед окажется у охраны.

msgs.text: Lab report's due at 5, not tomorrow. Did you see the email?
No! I'll finish the graphs now. Can you check the conclusion?

qs.stem: What did Aisha learn from the email?
opts: The deadline is earlier than they thought.
qs.ex: «Lab report's due at 5, not tomorrow» — срок сдачи сегодня в 5, раньше, чем они думали.

qs.stem: What does Aisha mean by "Send it over"?
opts: She will deliver the report herself.
She asks Ben to email the teacher.
She wants Ben to share the conclusion with her.
qs.ex: Бен просит проверить вывод, и Айша отвечает «Send it over» — «присылай». Она готова посмотреть текст.

doc.head: Language Café · This Thursday
paras: Practice Spanish, French, or Japanese with native speakers. Free, no booking — just bring a mug, since we no longer provide paper cups. 6–8 p.m., Student Union, Room 3.

qs.stem: What should participants bring?
qs.ex: «…just bring a mug, since we no longer provide paper cups».

qs.stem: What can be inferred about the Language Café?
opts: It is only for native speakers.
It used to provide paper cups.
qs.ex: «We no longer provide paper cups» — раньше стаканчики выдавали. Мероприятие бесплатное, и сказано только про этот четверг.

doc.head: QUICKFIX PHONES
doc.foot: Ready Wednesday after 2 p.m. Bring this ticket.

qs.stem: How much must the customer still pay?
qs.ex: «Balance — $40»: ремонт стоит $60, $20 уже оплачено.

qs.stem: When can the phone be collected?
opts: After the balance is paid online
qs.ex: «Ready Wednesday after 2 p.m.»

paras: Tree planting moved to Sunday because of storms. Same time, same place. Gloves provided, but bring your own water bottle — we're going plastic-free!

qs.stem: Why was the event moved?
qs.ex: «Tree planting moved to Sunday because of storms».

qs.stem: What has stayed the same?
qs.ex: «Same time, same place» — поменялся только день.

doc.head: RESERVED STUDY ROOMS
paras: Rooms not claimed within 15 minutes of the booking start are released to walk-in users. Repeated no-shows may lead to a two-week booking suspension.

qs.stem: What happens if a student arrives 20 minutes after their booking starts?
opts: The room is kept for the full hour.
The student must pay a fee.
The booking is moved to the next day.
The room may already have been given to someone else.
qs.ex: Если не занять комнату в течение 15 минут, она «released to walk-in users». Через 20 минут её уже могли отдать.

qs.stem: The word "no-shows" in the notice refers to
opts: bookings that people do not use
qs.ex: No-show — неявка: человек забронировал комнату и не пришёл.

doc.subject: Exam timetable
paras: The draft exam timetable is now online. Report clashes by March 3; after that, changes will be considered only for documented emergencies.

qs.stem: What should a student with two exams at the same time do?
opts: Ask a classmate to change exams
qs.ex: «Report clashes by March 3». Clash — накладка: два экзамена в одно время.

qs.stem: What is suggested about requests made after March 3?
opts: They must be made in person.
They need evidence of an emergency.
qs.ex: После 3 марта изменения рассматривают «only for documented emergencies» — нужна подтверждённая чрезвычайная ситуация.

msgs.text: Landlord says the heating fix is Friday, but only if someone's home to let them in.
I've got lectures all day. Could you swap your shift?
I'll ask. Otherwise it's next week.

qs.stem: What condition must be met for the repair to happen on Friday?
opts: The heating must be turned off.
qs.ex: «…only if someone's home to let them in».

qs.stem: What will most likely happen if Theo cannot change his shift?
opts: The landlord will enter without them.
The repair will be delayed until next week.
They will fix the heating themselves.
qs.ex: «I'll ask. Otherwise it's next week» — если смену поменять не выйдет, ремонт перенесут на следующую неделю.

doc.head: FREE FLU VACCINATIONS
paras: Walk-in clinic, Health Centre, Oct 10–14. Bring your student ID. Those with appointments are seen first; walk-in waiting times may exceed an hour at midday.

qs.stem: Which student is likely to wait the least?
opts: A walk-in student arriving at noon
qs.ex: «Those with appointments are seen first» — меньше всех ждёт тот, кто записан. 15 октября клиника уже не работает.

qs.stem: The word "exceed" in the notice is closest in meaning to
qs.ex: Exceed — превышать: ожидание может быть дольше часа.

paras: Selling last year's statistics textbook, $25. Note: the course switched editions, so check your syllabus before messaging — the old one won't match the assigned page numbers.

qs.stem: Why does Dana tell buyers to check their syllabus?
opts: The course now uses a different edition.
The book is for a different course.
qs.ex: «The course switched editions… the old one won't match the assigned page numbers».

qs.stem: Who would most likely find Dana's book useful?
opts: A student who needs the new edition
A student who wants the assigned page numbers to match the new edition
A student whose course still uses last year's edition
A teacher writing a new syllabus
qs.ex: Книга — прошлогоднее издание, поэтому подойдёт тому, у кого в программе это издание.
